title: Legato - East Nashville
description:
Enjoy this beautiful historic home full of friendly Southern charm in our AMAZING Cleveland Park, East Nashville neighborhood! We are just minutes from Broadway, Five Points, Nissan Stadium, and Vanderbilt. Walking distance to neighborhood spots like Folk restaurant, Red Headed Stranger, Mas Tacos, Coneheads Chicken, All People Coffee, The Pharmacy Burger, and more. We provide fresh linens, towels, shampoos, and all the basic necessities you will need to make your trip perfect. 12 guests max.

The space
This historic home was built in 1930, and still has the original fireplaces and wood floors. You’ll love relaxing in the rocking chairs and swing on the spacious front porch or chilling in the large backyard while cooking on the grill or playing with the cornhole and ladder golf sets.

There are three bedrooms and six beds - the primary bedroom has a king bed and a private full bath. The second and third bedrooms are upstairs and share a full bath.  One bedroom upstairs has a queen bed and the second bedroom has two queen beds.  There is also a queen pull-out sofa in the upstairs bonus room and one in the downstairs living room. All the bedrooms have mirrors and hairdryers to make getting ready for a night out easy, closets and/or dressers, sound machines beside each bed, and bedside tables with lights and space for nighttime reading. 12 guests max in home at one time.

Guest access
We will send you the door and alarm code the day before your arrival.

Other things to note
Please do not exceed 12 guests inside the house. No pets. $250 extra cleaning fee if pets are found to be on the premises. 
No local guests
